description: This file contains testing utilities for the Pipecat pipeline components, including mock frames, observers, test pipeline runner, and helper functions for testing frame processing in the pipeline.

classes.name: SleepFrame
classes.description: A system frame that introduces a sleep delay in the test pipeline, used to control timing between frame processing in tests.

classes.name: HeartbeatsObserver
classes.description: An observer that monitors for HeartbeatFrames from a specific FrameProcessor and invokes a callback when detected.

classes.name: QueuedFrameProcessor
classes.description: A FrameProcessor that captures frames in a queue for testing and inspection, optionally ignoring StartFrames.

methods.name: on_push_frame(self, data: FramePushed)
methods.description: Handles frame push events and detects HeartbeatFrames from a target processor.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: Frame, direction: FrameDirection)
methods.description: Processes frames, capturing them in a queue if they match the specified direction.

methods.name: Tuple[Sequence[Frame],Sequence[Frame]] run_test( processor: FrameProcessor, *, frames_to_send: Sequence[Frame], expected_down_frames: Optional[Sequence[type]] = None, expected_up_frames: Optional[Sequence[type]] = None, ignore_start: bool = True, observers: Optional[List[BaseObserver]] = None, pipeline_params: Optional[PipelineParams] = None, send_end_frame: bool = True, )
methods.description: Runs a test pipeline with specified frames and validates frame flow, returning the frames received downstream and upstream.

methods.name: __init__( self, *, queue: asyncio.Queue, queue_direction: FrameDirection, ignore_start: bool = True, )
__init__( self, *, target: FrameProcessor, heartbeat_callback: Callable[[FrameProcessor, HeartbeatFrame], Awaitable[None]], **kwargs, )
